bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root/.git" || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 62
cd "$root"
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 63
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = af5e1146d9f1b4a02fbe5cee1ba8995778c15364 || exit 64
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-link-verified-ipc.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_test_client.py > "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" || exit 65
test "$(git hash-object "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py")" = "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_test_client.py)" || exit 66
PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 67
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 68
echo VERIFIED_CLIENT_TO_RESIDENT_IPC=PASS
echo ORIGINAL_LOCAL_CLIENT=UNMODIFIED
